mcp.custom_install.help:
MCP server management
/mcp                         List configured servers
/mcp install                 Add a server with custom JSON
/mcp edit <name>             Edit server configuration
/mcp remove <name>           Remove a server
/mcp start <name>            Start a server
/mcp stop <name>             Stop a server
/mcp restart <name>          Restart a server
/mcp start-all               Start all servers
/mcp stop-all                Stop all servers
/mcp status [name]           Show status
/mcp logs <name> [limit]     Show server events
/mcp trust                   Manage project MCP trust
/mcp silence-warning         Silence unbound-server warnings
/mcp unsilence-warning       Restore unbound-server warnings
/mcp help                    Show this help
